grain: one provider/game_id/ply in move_evals, from the M3 fact_move sample
sampling: game ID SHA256 first eight bytes modulo 20 equals zero; deterministic 5% selection from the bounded prefix, independent of annotations
eligible: all sampled moves; no additional clock, phase, or opening filter
evaluable: both eval_before_cp_white and eval_after_cp_white are non-null
deterioration: max(0, mover-perspective cp_before minus cp_after); fact_move already inverts White-perspective scores for Black
numerator: sum of least(centipawn_deterioration, 1000) for evaluable moves with non-null deterioration
denominator: count of evaluable moves with non-null deterioration (required by publication)
null_rules: missing evaluations and mate transitions have null contribution and are excluded, never zero; zero denominator returns null; mate transitions remain separate coverage counts
caveats: Exploratory source-annotation proxy, not official Lichess accuracy or an engine strength ranking.
The 1000 cp cap is a contract constant, not an official Lichess rule.
Evaluation coverage is selected and source quality varies; the bounded prefix and deterministic game sample do not represent all games.
